annotations.text:
Dark theme — same warm family, inverted: ground #161410, cream ink #ede8dc, oxide accent lifted to #d9764f so it passes contrast on dark; button text goes dark on the accent.

The ink blocks (principles, case result, mobile emphasis row) become raised warm-charcoal panels (#211e18) instead of cream slabs — less glare at night. Tell me if you'd rather keep them as inverted cream blocks.

On the site the theme follows the system setting (prefers-color-scheme), no JS and no toggle.

Phone hero — three ways to make the portrait and the kicker read as one thing (the current layout leaves them as two orphans in one row).

A · Byline — small portrait inline with the kicker, like an author byline. Cheapest change, keeps the type-first hero. Trade-off: the portrait becomes a thumbnail.

B · Band — a landscape crop of the portrait across the column, the kicker as its caption. Strongest presence for the photo. Trade-off: pushes the headline ~150 px down and needs a crop that keeps the face.

C · Signature — kicker and headline first, the portrait with its “fig. 01” caption and the availability note just before the buttons. Closest to the desktop composition. Trade-off: the hero gets longer; the photo is seen after the pitch, not before.
